what: Workspace page load, real backend + real Postgres + production Next build, with a proxy adding 75 ms each way (about 150 ms round trip) between them. 'current production' hides the routes added in this branch (404), which is what today's deployed backend does.
data: Seeded like the production Phase 1 experiment: 16 generations (2.6 KB source each), 3 runs x 57 metric rows x 60 keys, 9 evaluations.
caveat: A local database answers in milliseconds, so this shows the effect of round trips and call counts, not production milliseconds. The production re-measure after deploy is the real number.

modes.mode: current production (batch manifests only; 404 probes for the new routes)

modes.note: session check, the workspace request, and the page-title lookup (runs in parallel)
modes.serverTimingExample: experiment;dur=0.9, generations_list;dur=3.3, correlation;dur=3.8, runs_list;dur=5.3, health;dur=3.3, drift;dur=3.4, manifests;dur=6.6, metrics_evaluations;dur=7.2, total;dur=13.4

parity: The full HTML document returned for the experiment page is byte-for-byte identical in all three modes (cmp), so only how the data is loaded changed, not what is shown.

edgeCases.experimentUnderWrongProject: not-found page, no workspace data in the body, same as before

tests.backendE2eAgainstRealPostgres: 243 passed in 18 files, including test/workspace.e2e-spec.ts (new): the workspace response equals the separate routes piece by piece; whole-experiment health/drift equal the per-run routes; Server-Timing lists every part; other users get 404
